_comment: Colors only. Every other setting is in the F12 in-game menu under QuickSell. Restart the game after editing. Delete this file to restore defaults.
_TierColors: Six colors, cheapest to most valuable: poor, common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary.
_PriceTierThresholds: Price PER SLOT at which each tier starts. Five values, so anything above the last is the sixth color.
_AmmoTierThresholds: Armour penetration bands used for ammo instead of price. Five values.
